label: the hit is the 10 pt draw size, not half the 16 pt token (B11)
the strip's inset is dropped, so every press lands 8 pt late
a bed press skips the clear (B5)
the pick-on-press dropped, so a drag moves the old pick
find: if !picked { press(target, modifiers: held, on: track, actions: actions) }

label: Escape skips the reverse step, so a cancel leaves keys moved
start and end zones swapped, so a press on a clip's right end trims its start
the snap skipped, so a trimmed end lands beside the playhead
find: let target = edits.snapped(raw, playhead: playhead, radius: Double(SuiteSize.timelineKeyframeHit / 2), scale: scale)

label: the key drag's release skips its own sample, so the last step is lost (#1796)
the trim's release skips its own sample, so the edge stops short (#1796)
find: _ = move(dx: dx, id: id, actions: actions)

label: endDrag fires per sample: every key drag step commits to the host (TL-22)
find: live.onMoveKeyframes = { [weak self] delta in self?.liveDelta += delta }
replace: live.onMoveKeyframes = { [weak self] delta in self?.liveDelta += delta; self?.commit() }

label: Escape keeps the move: a cancel commits the drag so far (TL-22)
find: guard active, drag != nil || trim != nil else { return false }
replace:
guard active, drag != nil || trim != nil else { return false }
        if var drag { _ = drag.release(actions: live) }

label: a trim commits per sample (TL-22)
find: live.onTrim = { [weak self] _, _, frame in self?.liveTrim = frame }
replace: live.onTrim = { [weak self] _, _, frame in self?.liveTrim = frame; self?.commit() }
